animations.empty: No animation yet. Select a character, or install animations in the application folder.

meshes.addHint: Drop a primitive at the origin of the scene
meshes.removeHint: Remove the selected meshes from the scene
meshes.empty: No mesh yet. Add one to get started.
meshes.noDocument: Open a scene to see its meshes.
meshes.boxHint: Six equal faces — the brick a scene is blocked out with
meshes.capsuleHint: A cylinder closed by two half-spheres
meshes.circleHint: A flat disc, seen from one side only
meshes.cylinderHint: A solid tube, its top and bottom radii set apart
meshes.latheHint: A profile turned around the vertical axis
meshes.octahedronHint: Eight triangular faces — two pyramids base to base
meshes.planeHint: A flat rectangle, seen from one side only
meshes.ringHint: A flat disc with a hole at its centre
meshes.torusKnotHint: A torus knotted through itself — the shape that judges a material best
meshes.tubeHint: A thin tube following a curve

lights.addHint: Drop a light source into the scene
lights.removeHint: Remove the selected lights from the scene
lights.empty: No light. The scene will stay black.
lights.noDocument: Open a scene to see its lights.
lights.ambientHint: Lights everything evenly, with no direction and no shadow
lights.directionalHint: Parallel light from infinitely far away, like the sun
lights.hemisphereHint: One colour coming from the sky, another from the ground
lights.pointHint: Radiates in every direction from a single point
lights.spotHint: A cone of light, with its angle and its softened edge

scene.noDocument: Open a scene to see its contents.
scene.renameHint: Opens the object’s name to be typed over, as a double-click on it does
scene.showHint: Brings the object back into view. Hiding it never took it out of the scene, this is not a delete
scene.hideHint: Takes the object out of the view without taking it out of the scene, to clear what it covers

objects.spriteHint: A flat image that always faces the camera
objects.textHint: Text set into the scene, with depth
objects.cameraHint: A stored point of view, beside the one being flown

transport.noClip: Select a clip to see it here.
transport.unreadable: This clip could not be shown: its media is missing, or its format cannot be read here.
transport.sourceRole: The clip you picked, as it is before the edit
transport.programRole: The whole edit, as it will be exported
transport.mirrorHint: Opens the edit in a window of its own, to put on a second screen
transport.fitHint: Brings the view back to the whole edit. Wheel to scroll, ⌘ + wheel to zoom
transport.envelopeHint: Traces the average level inside the wave, under the crests
transport.spectrumHint: Shows what the edit is made of while it plays, from bass to treble

timeline.noDocument: No sequence open. Create one to start editing.

addTrackHint.video: Adds an empty video track at the foot of the column
addTrackHint.audio: Adds an empty audio track at the foot of the column

timeline.trackActionsHint: Move the track through the stack, or remove it with what it carries
timeline.moveTrackUpHint: Swaps this track with the one above it
timeline.moveTrackDownHint: Swaps this track with the one below it
timeline.removeTrackHint: Removes the track and every clip it carries

videoTools.selectHint: Select, move and trim a clip
videoTools.bladeHint: Cut a clip under the pointer
videoTools.handHint: Scroll the timeline — wheel to zoom

sceneTools.selectHint: Pick an object without arming a handle
sceneTools.translateHint: Move the selected object along the axes
sceneTools.frameHint: Recentre the camera on the selected object
sceneTools.snapHint: Move the handles in regular steps, as coarse as the settings say
sceneTools.displayHint: Draw the surfaces, their edges, or both
sceneTools.spaceHint: Line the handles up with the object’s own orientation; when it is off, they follow the world axes

sceneViews.freeHint: The view being flown: the only one that turns
sceneViews.paneHint: Chooses what this quarter shows — a perspective, or an axis that does not turn
sceneViews.frontHint: Looks at the scene from the front, with no perspective
sceneViews.backHint: Looks at the scene from behind, with no perspective
sceneViews.leftHint: Looks at the scene from the left, with no perspective
sceneViews.rightHint: Looks at the scene from the right, with no perspective
sceneViews.topHint: Looks down on the scene, with no perspective
sceneViews.bottomHint: Looks up at the scene from below, with no perspective

sceneDisplay.shadedHint: Surfaces painted by their material, edges left out
sceneDisplay.wireframeHint: The edges alone — which is what shows how dense the mesh is
sceneDisplay.bothHint: Surfaces painted, with the edges drawn over them
sceneDisplay.solidHint: Plain clay on every surface: the shape, without the materials
sceneDisplay.materialHint: The materials under the studio light alone, with the scene’s own lights out
sceneDisplay.matcapHint: Lighting captured on a sphere: it is the relief that reads, not the colour
sceneDisplay.densityHint: Green to red by triangles per unit of surface: what is red is what to optimise

animation.noTrack: No track yet. Select an object, then add the track to animate.
animation.renderHint: Writes a video file of what the scene camera sees
animation.renderNeedsCamera: Add a camera to the scene to render it
animation.autoKeyHint: Moving an object writes a key instead of shifting its rest pose
animation.keySubjectHint: Keys every property of this object
animation.foldHint: Show or hide the animated properties
animation.keyAllHint: Keys every animated object at the playhead
animation.unkeySubjectHint: Removes the key standing here, on every property of this object
animation.addLaneHint: One more animation, played at the same time as the ones above
